title: Brazil climate-policy document inventory (compiled)
description: The inventory layer of Brazil's climate-policy document universe: one row per policy or climate-relevant planning instrument, indexed by its position in the policy stack (rollup) and the facet axes a coverage view needs (level, document type, strand, sector, territory, status). Covers BOTH the climate-badged instruments (NDC -> PNMC -> Plano Clima -> sectoral plans -> state/municipal climate plans) AND the mandatory non-climate MUNICIPAL carriers that hold climate-relevant commitments (Plano Diretor, sanitation, mobility, disaster-risk plans) — the layer where most Brazilian cities' local climate signal actually lives. Manufactured by compiling public government sources — not an ingested external dataset. Navigated by the landscape map knowledge-base/topics/climate-policy/br-climate-policy.md. Staging lane: not yet vetted through dataset-review. See collection.md for provenance, sources.yaml for the source registry, and references/carrier-types.csv for each municipal carrier's federal mandate + national registry.
grain: one row per climate-policy or climate-relevant planning instrument (document)

scope.in_scope: CLIMATE-BADGED instruments: National tier fully enumerated (NDC, PNMC framework law, Plano Clima 2024-2035, the two national strategies ENM/ENA, and all 7 mitigation + 16 adaptation sectoral/thematic plans, reconciled to MMA's published counts); State tier (the state climate policies/PEMC pinned to a law reference, ~16 of the 21 UFs reported to have one); Municipal tier (notable dedicated municipal climate action plans in capitals / large cities). MUNICIPAL CARRIERS (non-climate instruments carrying climate signal): a worked sample of 4 carrier types (Plano Diretor, saneamento, mobilidade, gestao-riscos) x the 7 anchor cities that have a dedicated climate plan (Sao Paulo, Rio, Salvador, Recife, Curitiba, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre) = 28 carrier rows. Carrier federal mandates + national registries are in references/carrier-types.csv.
scope.not_yet_in_scope: The full 21-UF state-law set (5-8 UFs reported to have a climate law but not yet pinned to a verified reference). The municipal climate-plan long tail (only ~7 of 5,570 municipalities have a climate LAW; dedicated plans ~10-40). The full-country carrier enumeration: carriers are here as a 7-city sample only — extension to all 5,570 municipalities is feasible via the national registries (IBGE MUNIC carries a variable for all four carrier types; SINISA for sanitation; CENAD/CEMADEN cadastro for disaster risk) but not yet done. Per-plan PDF deep-links for the 23 sectoral plans (gov.br blocks automated fetch; only the documentos-oficiais hub is verified). Instrument full text / signal extraction (that is the downstream signals layer).
scope.complete_when: Every national instrument present with a fetched source_url (done for the umbrella 5; pending per-plan PDFs for the 23 sectoral plans); all 21 state PEMCs pinned to a verified law reference; the sector-plan lead-ministry field promoted from inferred to source-read; the municipal carrier sample extended to the full municipality set via the IBGE MUNIC backbone and the anchor-city partials pinned; territory_code/region computed by rule for every row (done via references/br-uf-codes.csv).

field_provenance_legend.sourced: read directly from a primary source (verifiable against source_url)
field_provenance_legend.derived: assigned by the compiler's judgment, NOT stated in the source — lower-trust until a deterministic rule is defined
field_provenance_legend.derived-by-rule: computed by an explicit, auditable lookup/rule (references/*), reproducible and correctable in one place

fields.name: stack_tier
fields.notes: Position in the policy stack (per the landscape map). The rollup that determines a document's shape and how it applies. The last four values are the mandatory MUNICIPAL non-climate carriers; their federal mandate + national registry are in references/carrier-types.csv. Expected to be lopsided (national deep, municipal thin) — that lopsidedness is the finding, not a gap.

fields.name: source_level
fields.notes: Territorial scale; drives applicability (national applies to all, state/municipal only where the instrument exists).

fields.name: strand
fields.notes: For sectoral plans the strand is stated by the source (ENM vs ENA); for frameworks/NDC assigned (cross-cutting). For carriers, assigned from the carrier's climate signal (plano-diretor=cross-cutting, saneamento=adaptation, mobilidade=mitigation, gestao-riscos=adaptation).

fields.name: sector
fields.notes: For national sectoral plans, the sector/theme verbatim from MMA's list; for municipal carriers, the carrier's domain (Ordenamento Territorial, Saneamento, Mobilidade Urbana, Gestao de Riscos); null for umbrella/framework/state/municipal-climate-plan instruments.

fields.name: title_pt
fields.notes: Official Portuguese title. For the 23 sectoral plans, reconstructed to MMA's naming convention ('Plano Setorial de [Mitigacao/Adaptacao] - [Setor]') — exact cover wording is med-confidence pending per-PDF fetch (verified=false).

fields.name: publisher
fields.notes: Issuing body. For national umbrella docs and states: source-read. For the 23 sectoral plans, the LEAD MINISTRY is mostly INFERRED from Brazil's ministerial structure (only Cidades and the MMA/MCTI/Casa Civil coordinating roles are confirmed) — flagged per row via verified=false + confidence.

fields.name: uf_code
fields.notes: 2-letter UF for state/municipal rows; 'BR' for national.

fields.name: territory_code
fields.notes: IBGE-based: 'BR' national; 2-digit IBGE UF code for state; 7-digit IBGE municipality code for municipal. Assigned via references/br-uf-codes.csv (UF->IBGE) and the municipality codes in that file. Not stated in the source.

fields.name: region
fields.notes: IBGE macro-region, via references/br-uf-codes.csv; 'BR' for national.

fields.name: law_ref
fields.notes: Enabling law / decree where the instrument is a legal act (framework law, state policies, some municipal). Null for plans/strategies that are administrative documents.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: final/published = issued administrative document; in-force = enacted law; uncertain = existence/status not fully confirmed (low-confidence rows).

fields.name: access_type
fields.notes: How the source resolves: pdf = direct document; portal = gov.br hub landing (per-plan PDF behind it); law-portal = legislative/official-gazette page.

fields.name: verified
fields.notes: true = a primary source URL was fetched/confirmed in this pass. false = corroborated by secondary sources or a hub page but the specific document link/title/ministry was not directly fetched.

fields.name: confidence
fields.notes: Research confidence in the row's identity (title + reference + publisher).

fields.name: notes
fields.notes: Free text: caveats, amendments, cross-references, what remains to confirm.

promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (pin remaining state laws, fetch per-plan PDFs to source-read titles + lead ministries, scope the non-climate municipal carriers, complete provenance) -> catalog + pipeline -> the coverage/applicability layer that turns this inventory into a per-city policy environment.
